title: Self propelled! Easy to clean out and strong suction.
text:
Self propelled! Easy to clean out and strong suction.. So far this Shark duoclean Cordless Ultra-light vacuum is fantastic!

It has a strong suction and it's self propelled! It being self propelled does make it a little tougher to pull back, but not a struggle, just noting that it's suction and self propel might be harder for an older or disabled person with little strength to pull back. Of course, they can always just use it going forward in a square type of pattern. That would be super easy!

The dust container is very easy to clean out. You can also wash the filter. It won't hold a smell like the Dyson cordless. I can't clean my Dyson Cordless. I love this feature.

My only complaint? The attachments don't ride onboard. This would make it a right next door to perfect vacuum!

It came with 2 batteries, which is awesome! One battery can be charging while the other is in use.
